blocks.directed: AHAM: The Divine I and the Universe in Reverse

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta takes the entire universe, folds it into three Sanskrit phonemes, reveals why the Supreme Lord's “I” is not the same as your ego having a particularly ambitious Tuesday, quotes Utpaladeva on the resting place of consciousness, recites his own magnificent hymn to the Goddess, and then explains how sixty years of divine activity can somehow be contemplated within a single breath.

blocks.text: What is the nature of the awareness through which these changing contents become manifest?
blocks.directed: What is the nature of the awareness through which these changing contents become manifest?

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: The repose of Prakāśa in itself is I-consciousness.
blocks.directed: The repose of Prakāśa in itself is I-consciousness.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta then interprets the entire phonemic universe through that same reality.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta then interprets the entire phonemic universe through that same reality.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself

blocks.text: Yet none of these transformations creates an independently ultimate second consciousness.
blocks.directed: Yet none of these transformations creates an independently ultimate second consciousness.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: And that is why he can say:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And that is why he can say:

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: Aham and its reverse represent two directions of one reality.
blocks.directed: Aham and its reverse represent two directions of one reality.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: Manifestation and withdrawal aren't separate Absolutes.
blocks.directed: Manifestation and withdrawal aren't separate Absolutes.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: The underlying conscious freedom remains undivided.
blocks.directed: The underlying conscious freedom remains undivided.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: But here's the really important part.
blocks.directed: But here's the really important part.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: The universal I-consciousness doesn't become complete after it has finished manifesting the universe.
blocks.directed: The universal I-consciousness doesn't become complete after it has finished manifesting the universe.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: And it doesn't need to destroy the universe in order to become complete again.
blocks.directed: And it doesn't need to destroy the universe in order to become complete again.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: The acts of manifestation and withdrawal express that fullness.
blocks.directed: The acts of manifestation and withdrawal express that fullness.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: Śiva does not need to become himself. His self-revealing freedom is already the ground of every becoming.
blocks.directed: Śiva does not need to become himself. His self-revealing freedom is already the ground of every becoming.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: Now that is a beautiful distinction.
blocks.directed: Now that is a beautiful distinction.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: Because it means the entire universe, in Abhinavagupta's metaphysics, is not a journey from the absence of consciousness into consciousness.
blocks.directed: Because it means the entire universe, in Abhinavagupta's metaphysics, is not a journey from the absence of consciousness into consciousness.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: It is a manifestation of the conscious reality that was never absent.
blocks.directed: It is a manifestation of the conscious reality that was never absent.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: And the supreme Aham isn't merely one more word in the dictionary.
blocks.directed: And the supreme Aham isn't merely one more word in the dictionary.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: It's a sacred expression of the self-apprehending nature of awareness.
blocks.directed: It's a sacred expression of the self-apprehending nature of awareness.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: The written word is a symbol.
blocks.directed: The written word is a symbol.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: The phonemes are a symbolic structure.
blocks.directed: The phonemes are a symbolic structure.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: The philosophical teaching is an explanation.
blocks.directed: The philosophical teaching is an explanation.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: But the conscious ground is what the explanation is meant to disclose.
blocks.directed: But the conscious ground is what the explanation is meant to disclose.

blocks.section: 23. The final insight - The I doesn't have to become itself
blocks.text: And now, after nineteen installments, we've finally reached the word that contains the entire alphabet.
blocks.directed: And now, after nineteen installments, we've finally reached the word that contains the entire alphabet.
